comment: Per-resort corrections applied by pipeline/normalize_osm.py (ADR-036). See whistler-blackcomb.overrides.json for the format. One polygon, way/256024127 (Attitash Mountain Resort): Attitash and Bear Peak, joined by Bear Notch Pass, on one ticket and one map; it holds every lift and run of the resort. The Bear Notch Ski Touring Center, a separate nordic centre on Bear Notch Road west of Bear Peak, is a listed neighbour (resorts.json). Every named run and lift checked on 2026-11-12 against Attitash's 2025-26 winter trail map (attitash.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-maps.aspx, 20251226_AT_winter-trail_map_001.pdf), the only map the page lists: the site serves curl an error page and the page was read with WebFetch, and the painting was read from the PDF's full-size copy on the resort's image server (scene7, 4990 x 3539 px), tile by tile. The legend has Easier (green circle), More Difficult (blue square) and Most Difficult (one black diamond), as OSM's easy, intermediate and advanced, Terrain Park in orange and Glades (a tree icon, no difficulty symbol); there is no double black. The resort's lift and terrain status page loads by script, so the printed map is the only source and wins. Of OSM's named runs, all carry the map's rating but Illusion (black from Bear Peak's summit to the base; intermediate in OSM), Lower Highway (L. HIGHWAY, blue; easy in OSM) and three short pieces of Bear Notch Pass (72 m, easy in OSM; the map draws the pass blue). Middle Ptarmigan is one OSM way from Upper Far Out to the base that the map draws black (M. PTARMIGAN) and then blue below Middle Highway (L. PTARMIGAN): it stays advanced end to end, the harder, as Stowe's Upper Toll Road. The glades the map marks with the tree icon and no difficulty symbol (Barksville, Lumberyard and Broken Arrow Glades, OSM run areas rated advanced) keep OSM's tags: no rating is guessed. Parks: Arcade, drawn orange beside Barksville Glade, and the lane below Middle Kachina that the map draws orange and labels SKI-BALL (OSM's Lower Kachina, a line and a snow_park outline) get the park flag (the outline is a snow park already), and the lane the map's name. Names from the map: Ammonoosuc (OSM Ammonousuc), Barksville Glade (OSM Barksville Glad), Stony Brook and Stony Brook Bypass (OSM Stoney Brook and Stoney Brook By Pass), Lower Morning Star for the run OSM names Lower Snowdancer (the map's L. MORNING STAR, from the junction of Morning Star and Snow Dancer down the east boundary to Bear Notch Pass; OSM's Snowdancer is the map's SNOW DANCER from the Abenaki Quad's top), and the lift Progression Quad (OSM Progression). Names that differ from the map only by a space, an abbreviation or an article stay as OSM has them: Snowdancer (SNOW DANCER), Upper and Lower Myth Maker (MYTHMAKER), Blueberrylane (BLUEBERRY LANE), Hall Street (HALL ST.), the Upper, Middle and Lower of Saco, Highway, Kachina and Ptarmigan (U., M., L.), Far Out for the map's U. FAR OUT (blue) and L. FAR OUT (green), OSM's two ways so rated, Tim's Trauma (TIM'S) and the lift The Mountaineer (MOUNTAINEER). Lifts: the map's eight (Flying Yankee, Mountaineer, Progression Quad, Learning Center Triple and the Snowbelt carpet at Attitash; Abenaki Quad, Kachina Triple and Flying Bear at Bear Peak) are all in OSM, none hidden. Hidden: five closed outlines of unnamed glades (natural=wood without area=yes, rated advanced) that would draw as runs looping round the woods, three at Attitash and two at Bear Peak, as Okemo's are. OSM gaps (shipped as at Palisades Tahoe): Hunky Dory (blue, beside Lower Highway), Bumper (blue, Bear Peak), Ski Way (green, at Bear Peak's base), Quiver Glade, the stretch of Arcade above Tilt, Lower Ptarmigan as a run of its own, and the Snowbelt beginner slope, which OSM tags piste:type=yes (left out by the type rule).

overrides.reason: Illusion, from Bear Peak's summit along the west side to Crawford Path and the base, is drawn black with the Most Difficult diamond from top to bottom on Attitash's 2025-26 winter trail map (attitash.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-maps.aspx, 20251226_AT_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, read from its full-size copy on the resort's image server); OSM rates it intermediate. The printed map wins.

Lower Highway is drawn blue with the More Difficult square (L. HIGHWAY) on Attitash's 2025-26 winter trail map (attitash.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-maps.aspx, 20251226_AT_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, read from its full-size copy on the resort's image server); OSM rates it easy. The printed map wins.

A 24 m piece of Bear Notch Pass, the two-way trail between Attitash and Bear Peak, is rated easy in OSM while the pass's other ways are intermediate; Attitash's 2025-26 winter trail map (attitash.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-maps.aspx, 20251226_AT_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, read from its full-size copy on the resort's image server) draws BEAR NOTCH PASS blue with the More Difficult square. The printed map wins.

Attitash's 2025-26 winter trail map (attitash.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-maps.aspx, 20251226_AT_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, read from its full-size copy on the resort's image server) labels this black trail below Attitash's summit AMMONOOSUC (after the river); OSM spells it Ammonousuc. Name from the map.

Attitash's 2025-26 winter trail map (attitash.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-maps.aspx, 20251226_AT_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, read from its full-size copy on the resort's image server) labels this glade BARKSVILLE GLADE (with the glade icon); OSM spells it Barksville Glad. Name from the map; OSM's rating is kept (the map gives its glades no difficulty symbol).

Attitash's 2025-26 winter trail map (attitash.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-maps.aspx, 20251226_AT_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, read from its full-size copy on the resort's image server) labels this green trail STONY BROOK; OSM spells it Stoney Brook. Name from the map.

Attitash's 2025-26 winter trail map (attitash.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-maps.aspx, 20251226_AT_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, read from its full-size copy on the resort's image server) labels this blue trail STONY BROOK BYPASS; OSM spells it Stoney Brook By Pass. Name from the map.

OSM names this blue trail Lower Snowdancer: it runs from the junction where Morning Star (from Bear Peak's summit) and Snowdancer (from the Abenaki Quad's top) meet, down the east boundary to Bear Notch Pass. Attitash's 2025-26 winter trail map (attitash.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-maps.aspx, 20251226_AT_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, read from its full-size copy on the resort's image server) labels that trail L. MORNING STAR, below MORNING STAR, and SNOW DANCER only the stretch from the Abenaki Quad's top. Name from the map.

OSM's Lower Kachina, the lane from the bottom of Middle Kachina down the east side of Barksville Glade to the Abenaki Quad's base, is drawn orange as terrain park and labelled SKI-BALL on Attitash's 2025-26 winter trail map (attitash.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-maps.aspx, 20251226_AT_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, read from its full-size copy on the resort's image server), which labels no Lower Kachina; OSM has it as a blue run with no park tag (and maps the park as an outline of the same name). Park flag and name from the map; OSM's rating is kept.

The outline of the terrain park on OSM's Lower Kachina (a snow_park area) is labelled SKI-BALL in orange on Attitash's 2025-26 winter trail map (attitash.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-maps.aspx, 20251226_AT_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, read from its full-size copy on the resort's image server), which labels no Lower Kachina. Name from the map, as for the park's line.

Arcade, beside Barksville Glade below Tilt, is drawn orange as terrain park (ARCADE, with the park's features) on Attitash's 2025-26 winter trail map (attitash.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-maps.aspx, 20251226_AT_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, read from its full-size copy on the resort's image server), with no difficulty symbol; OSM rates it intermediate and has no park tag. Park flag from the map; OSM's rating is kept.

Attitash's 2025-26 winter trail map (attitash.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-maps.aspx, 20251226_AT_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, read from its full-size copy on the resort's image server) labels this chair PROGRESSION QUAD, as it names the Abenaki Quad, the Kachina Triple and the Learning Center Triple; OSM names it Progression. Name from the map.
